author: Aritra Dutta

contents.content:
Bangalore,known for its exciting nightlife, has an ample number of pubs to suit every mood or taste. Bangalore  has all you might want, whether you're searching for a fun place to dance the evening away or a nice place to have few drinks with friends. We'll explore the city's top bars with dance floors to make sure you have an amazing time.


 Table Of Contents

Bangalore partygoers associate Big Brewsky with delicious cuisine, amazing craft beer, and of course, dancing and music. This microbrewery will give you a memorable evening thanks to its unique lighting, first-rate service, amazing menu, romantic atmosphere, and captivating décor. And wait, there's a pool inside the pub.The resident DJ spins upbeat music that keeps you swinging after a few drinks. They have some delicious continental, Indian, and Italian cuisine.

Location: 10/62/2A/2 & 3, Sarjapur Main Rd, behind MK Retail, near Wipro Corporate Office, Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560035
Timings: 12:30 pm to 1:00 am; every day
Cost for Two: ₹ 1600 (approx.)

Situated within Vivanta , Ranked as one of Bangalore's top dance clubs by Taj, one of the most luxurious hotels in the area, is Ice Bar. Great ambience surrounds the poolside seating area, where you can relax and enjoy the evening while your drinks are mixed by expert mixologists and lively music is mixed by the DJ. Making reservations in advance is required, as access to the club is granted based on a prepared guest list. Their Continental cuisine will keep your engine running while you dance the night away.

Location: Taj Mg Road, 41/3, Mahatma Gandhi Rd, Opposite 1 MG - Lido Mall, Halasuru, Yellappa Garden, Yellappa Chetty Layout, Sivanchetti Gardens, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001
Timings:
11:00 am to 11:30 pm (Sunday to Thursday)
11:00 am to 12:30 am (Fridays and Saturdays)
Cost for Two: ₹ 2800 (approx.)

Let's start with Skyye Lounge, one of Bangalore's most recognizable, well-liked, and essential bars. Situated on the 16th level of UB City, this alfresco lounge presents breathtaking city vistas. Their dance floor and cuisine are also excellent. Skyye guarantees you an amazing experience beneath the stars with its under-lit flooring, round counter, rooftop swimming pool, and mind-blowing light.

Location: 24, 16th Floor, Uber level, Canberra Block, UB City, Vittal Mallya Rd, KG Halli, D' Souza Layout, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001
Timings:
5:30 pm to 11:00 pm (Sunday to Thursday)
5:30 pm to 1:00 am (Fridays and Saturdays)
Cost for Two: ₹ 2500 (approx.)

If dancing is an art form, Loft 38 is the place to let out your creative side. This modern loft-style room has wide windows, raised seating, and a rustic, woodsy feel exactly what the name says. In addition to enjoying some cocktails and mocktails and delectable Continental, American, Indian, and Asian cuisine, you may dance till you drop on the spacious dance floor. The space is lighted by purple neon bulbs, which significantly increases the festive atmosphere.

Location:Shop No, 763, 100 Feet Rd, next to Xtreme Sports Bar, HAL 2nd Stage, Appareddipalya, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038
Timings:
12:30 pm to 11:30 pm (Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Sunday)
12:30 pm to 12:30 am (Tuesday, Friday, and Saturday)
Cost for Two: ₹ 2100 (approx.)

Remember not to judge a book by its cover.It's one of Bangalore's greatest dancing pubs, not a bakery or dessert business. The Le Meridien location is well-known for its dance floor, open pool area, live music, Bollywood nights, and amiable staff. Their beer selection, finger food, and cocktails are all quite exceptional. And more! The stylish furnishings of this trendy party spot feature multicolored chairs, psychedelic lighting, and eye-catching wall décor. This place plays jazz music that will keep you up and dancing all night.

Location: Le Meridien Hotel, 28, Sankey Road, Palace Cross Rd, Vasanth Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560052
Timings: 11:00 am to 1:00 pm; every day
Cost for Two: ₹ 2000 (approx.)

Would you like to dance outside under the trees as a DJ plays tunes to keep you moving? We know where you need to be headed, though: Pebble. Located in the city center, this pub with a jungle theme has everything you need for an amazing dance night, including finger food that tastes fantastic, lively music, rustic décor, excellent drinks, and an earthy, raw vibe. Deep House, Dubstep, and Psytrance are among the genres of music played here, and they all work incredibly well with the drinks.

Location: Gate number 9, Princess Academy, Palace Grounds 3 , Ramana Maharishi Road, Bellary Rd, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560080
Timings:
7:00 pm to 11:30 pm (Sunday to Thursday)
7:00 pm to 1:00 am (Fridays and Saturdays) 
Cost for Two: ₹ 1500 (approx.)

Would you like to spend a night sampling well-made beer and learning some new dancing moves? Visit Vapor Pub and Brewery, one of Bangalore's best-rated microbreweries. On top of its rooftop DJ booth, this well-liked dance destination offers breathtaking views of the green belt that encircles the neighborhood. After dancing for a while, make sure to indulge in delectable foods from their menu, which offers Chinese, Continental, and North Indian cuisines.

Location: 773, 100 Feet Rd, HAL 2nd Stage, Doopanahalli, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038
Timings: 12:00 pm to 12:30 pm; every day
Cost for Two: ₹ 1400 (approx.)

Factors to Consider When Choosing a Pub

When selecting a pub with a dance floor in Bangalore, there are several factors to keep in mind:
Location and Accessibility
Think about where the bar is located and how convenient it is to go to from where you are starting from. For most visitors, pubs in key locations like MG Road, Brigade Road, and Koramangala are more handy.
Timings and Best Days to Visit
In Bangalore, the majority of pubs are open from late afternoon into the wee hours of the morning. The best days to go, meanwhile, could change based on the theme or special activities of the bar. For the most recent information about the pub's schedule and forthcoming events, it's a good idea to visit their website or social media accounts.
Cost Estimates and Reservation Advice
The cost of a pub varies according to geography, cuisine, and knowledge. It's a good idea to know how much you can afford before choosing a pub. Make arrangements in advance to avoid any issues, as some locations especially on weekends or during major events may need reservations.
Dress Code and Entry Requirements
The majority of pubs in Bangalore have a smart casual dress code. It's usually a good idea to find out the precise dress code and admission requirements of the bar, as some may have age restrictions or additional legal criteria.

Conclusion

Bangalore has an amazing nightlife society with many of different bars that have amazing dance floors and great memories. There is a bar out there that matches your tastes and makes sure you have a great evening. So gather your buddies, get dressed up, and prepare to have a great time dancing in one of Bangalore's best bars of the evening.
